notes: Target load is offered events/sec, not a capacity estimate. Burst offers the same count within the first quarter of the window.

HTTP acknowledgement is measured per successful request, including client encoding/network/broker acknowledgement. No automatic load-driver retries. Visibility percentiles use only first observations made by the pending observer (ObservedEvents), not rows first found by final verification. AmbiguousUnobserved means absent at final bounded verification.

Storage latency is a per-event receipt-to-first-observed-committed-row upper bound. Receipt and SQL clock timestamps share the deployment VM clock; the SQL clock is queried after reading the committed-row result. Includes polling, query and clock-probe delay; persisted_at is not used. Host time only schedules load/backlog.

VerifiedCompletionEPS is an audit-completion rate, not SQL capacity: independently verified unique rows / (measured window plus request tail and complete observation/verification drain); accepted EPS counts only acknowledgements completed inside the measured window. Late starts and acknowledgements are reported separately. Limited outcomes are not achieved-load/capacity claims. See raw durations.
ID sets are reconciled in memory; sorted unique IDs joined by newline (no trailing newline) are SHA-256 hashed for bounded public evidence. Recreate IDs from seed plus repetition and event index.
Generator misses mean its bounded queue could not keep up; late schedules count scheduler delays beyond one request interval. Shared-host generator/observer compete with services.
